paragraphs.text: Revelation of St. John

After the taking up of our Lord Jesus Christ, I John was alone upon Mount Tabor, where also He showed us His undefiled Godhead; and as I was not able to stand, I fell upon the ground, and prayed to the Lord, and said: O Lord my God, who has deemed me worthy to be Your servant, hear my voice, and teach me about Your coming. When You shall come to the earth, what will happen? The heaven and the earth, and the sun and the moon, what will happen to them in those times? Reveal to me all; for I am emboldened, because You listen to Your servant.

And I spent seven days praying; and after this a cloud of light caught me up from the mountain, and set me before the face of the heaven. And I heard a voice saying to me: Look up, John, servant of God, and know. And having looked up, I saw the heaven opened, and there came forth from within the heaven a smell of perfumes of much sweet odour; and I saw an exceeding great flood of light, more resplendent than the sun. And again I heard a voice saying to me: Behold, righteous John. And I directed my sight, and saw a book lying, of the thickness, methought, of seven mountains; and the length of it the mind of man cannot comprehend, having seven seals. And I said: O Lord my God, reveal to me what is written in this book. And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. In this book which you see there have been written the things in the heaven, and the things in the earth, and the things in the abyss, and the judgments and righteousness of all the human race. And I said: Lord, when shall these things come to pass? And what do those times bring? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. There shall be in that time abundance of grain and wine, such as there has never been upon the earth, nor shall ever be until those times come. Then the ear of grain shall produce a half chœnix, and the bend of the branch shall produce a thousand clusters, and the cluster shall produce a half jar of wine; and in the following year there shall not be found upon the face of all the earth a half chœnix of grain or a half jar of wine.

And again I said: Lord, thereafter what will You do? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Then shall appear the denier, and he who is set apart in the darkness, who is called Antichrist. And again I said: Lord, reveal to me what he is like. And I heard a voice saying to me: The appearance of his face is dusky; the hairs of his head are sharp, like darts; his eyebrows like a wild beast's; his right eye like the star which rises in the morning, and the other like a lion's; his mouth about one cubit; his teeth span long; his fingers like scythes; the print of his feet of two spans; and on his face an inscription, Antichrist; he shall be exalted even to heaven, and shall be cast down even to Hades, making false displays. And then will I make the heaven brazen, so that it shall not give moisture upon the earth; and I will hide the clouds in secret places, so that they shall not bring moisture upon the earth; and I will command the horns of the wind, so that the wind shall not blow upon the earth.

And again I said: Lord, and how many years will he do this upon the earth? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Three years shall those times be; and I will make the three years like three months, and the three months like three weeks, and the three weeks like three days, and the three days like three hours, and the three hours like three seconds, as said the prophet David, His throne have You broken down to the ground; You have shortened the days of his time; You have poured shame upon him. And then I shall send forth Enoch and Elias to convict him; and they shall show him to be a liar and a deceiver; and he shall kill them at the altar, as said the prophet, Then shall they offer calves upon Your altar.

And again I said: Lord, and after that what will come to pass? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Then all the human race shall die, and there shall not be a living man upon all the earth. And again I said: Lord, after that what will You do? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Then will I send forth mine angels, and they shall take the ram's horns that lie upon the cloud; and Michael and Gabriel shall go forth out of the heaven and sound with those horns, as the prophet David foretold, With the voice of a trumpet of horn. And the voice of the trumpet shall be heard from the one quarter of the world to the other; and from the voice of that trumpet all the earth shall be shaken, as the prophet foretold, And at the voice of the bird every plant shall arise; that is, at the voice of the archangel all the human race shall arise.

And again I said: Lord, those who are dead from Adam even to this day, and who dwell in Hades from the beginning of the world, and who die at the last ages, what like shall they arise? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. All the human race shall arise thirty years old.

And again I said: Lord, they die male and female, and some old, and some young, and some infants. In the resurrection what like shall they arise? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Just as the bees are, and differ not one from another, but are all of one appearance and one size, so also shall every man be in the resurrection. There is neither fair, nor ruddy, nor black, neither Ethiopian nor different countenances; but they shall all arise of one appearance and one stature. All the human race shall arise without bodies, as I told you that in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God.

And again I said: Lord, is it possible in that world to recognise each other, a brother his brother, or a friend his friend, or a father his own children, or the children their own parents? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, John. To the righteous there is recognition, but to the sinners not at all; they cannot in the resurrection recognise each other. And again I John said: Lord, is there there recollection of the things that are here, either fields or vineyards, or other things here? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. The prophet David speaks, saying, I remembered that we are dust: as for man, his days are as grass; as a flower of the field, so he shall flourish: for a wind has passed over it, and it shall be no more, and it shall not any longer know its place. And again the same said: His spirit shall go forth, and he returns to his earth; in that day all his thoughts shall perish.

And again I said: Lord, and after that what will You do? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Then will I send forth mine angels over the face of all the earth, and they shall lift off the earth everything honourable, and everything precious, and the venerable and holy images, and the glorious and precious crosses, and the sacred vessels of the churches, and the divine and sacred books; and all the precious and holy things shall be lifted up by clouds into the air. And then will I order to be lifted up the great and venerable sceptre, on which I stretched forth my hands, and all the orders of my angels shall do reverence to it. And then shall be lifted up all the race of men upon clouds, as the Apostle Paul foretold. {{BIBLE:1th 4:17}} Along with them we shall be snatched up in clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And then shall come forth every evil spirit, both in the earth and in the abyss, wherever they are on the face of all the earth, from the rising of the sun even to the setting, and they shall be united to him that is served by the devil, that is, Antichrist, and they shall be lifted up upon the clouds.

And again I said: Lord, and after that what will You do? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Then shall I send forth mine angels over the face of all the earth, and they shall burn up the earth eight thousand five hundred cubits, and the great mountains shall be burnt up, and all the rocks shall be melted and shall become as dust, and every tree shall be burnt up, and every beast, and every creeping thing creeping upon the earth, and every thing moving upon the face of the earth, and every flying thing flying in the air; and there shall no longer be upon the face of all the earth anything moving, and the earth shall be without motion.

And again I said: Lord, and after that what will You do? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Then shall I uncover the four parts of the east, and there shall come forth four great winds, and they shall sweep all the face of the earth from the one end of the earth to the other; and the Lord shall sweep sin from off the earth, and the earth shall be made white like snow, and it shall become as a leaf of paper, without cave, or mountain, or hill, or rock; but the face of the earth from the rising even to the setting of the sun shall be like a table, and white as snow; and the reins of the earth shall be consumed by fire, and it shall cry unto me, saying, I am a virgin before you, O Lord, and there is no sin in me; as the prophet David said aforetime, You shall sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be made pure; You shall wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow. And again he said: Every chasm shall be filled up, and every mountain and hill brought low, and the crooked places shall be made straight, and the rough ways into smooth; and all flesh shall see the salvation of God. {{BIBLE:isa 40:4}}

And again I said: Lord, and after that what will You do? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Then shall the earth be cleansed from sin, and all the earth shall be filled with a sweet smell, because I am about to come down upon the earth; and then shall come forth the great and venerable sceptre, with thousands of angels worshipping it, as I said before; and then shall appear the sign of the Son of man from the heaven with power and great glory. {{BIBLE:mat 24:30}} And then the worker of iniquity with his servants shall behold it, and gnash his teeth exceedingly, and all the unclean spirits shall be turned to flight. And then, seized by invisible power, having no means of flight, they shall gnash their teeth against him, saying to him: Where is your power? How have you led us astray? And we have fled away, and have fallen away from the glory which we had beside Him who is coming to judge us, and the whole human race. Woe to us! Because He banishes us into outer darkness.

And again I said: Lord, and after that what will You do? And I heard a voice saying to me: Then will I send an angel out of heaven, and he shall cry with a loud voice, saying, Hear, O earth, and be strong, says the Lord; for I am coming down to you. And the voice of the angel shall be heard from the one end of the world even to the other, and even to the remotest part of the abyss. And then shall be shaken all the power of the angels and of the many-eyed ones, and there shall be a great noise in the heavens, and the nine regions of the heaven shall be shaken, and there shall be fear and astonishment upon all the angels. And then the heavens shall be rent from the rising of the sun even to the setting, and an innumerable multitude of angels shall come down to the earth; and then the treasures of the heavens shall be opened, and they shall bring down every precious thing, and the perfume of incense, and they shall bring down to the earth Jerusalem robed like a bride. {{BIBLE:rev 21:2}} And then there shall go before me myriads of angels and archangels, bearing my throne, crying out, Holy, holy, holy, Lord of Sabaoth; heaven and earth are full of Your glory. {{BIBLE:isa 6:3}} And then will I come forth with power and great glory, and every eye in the clouds shall see me; and then every knee shall bend, of things in heaven, and things on earth, and things under the earth. {{BIBLE:phi 2:10}} And then the heaven shall remain empty; and I will come down upon the earth, and all that is in the air shall be brought down upon the earth, and all the human race and every evil spirit along with Antichrist, and they shall all be set before me naked, and chained by the neck.

And again I said: Lord, what will become of the heavens, and the sun, and the moon, along with the stars? And I heard a voice saying to me: Behold, righteous John. And I looked, and saw a Lamb having seven eyes and seven horns. {{BIBLE:rev 5:6}} And again I heard a voice saying to me: I will bid the Lamb come before me, and will say, Who will open this book? And all the multitudes of the angels will answer, Give this book to the Lamb to open it. And then will I order the book to be opened. And when He shall open the first seal, the stars of the heaven shall fall, from the one end of it to the other. And when He shall open the second seal, the moon shall be hidden, and there shall be no light in her. And when He shall open the third seal, the light of the sun shall be withheld, and there shall not be light upon the earth. And when He shall open the fourth seal, the heavens shall be dissolved, and the air shall be thrown into utter confusion, as says the prophet: And the heavens are the works of Your hands; they shall perish, but You endure, and they shall all wax old as a garment. And when He shall open the fifth seal, the earth shall be rent, and all the tribunals upon the face of all the earth shall be revealed. And when He shall open the sixth seal, the half of the sea shall disappear. And when He shall open the seventh seal, Hades shall be uncovered.

And I said: Lord, who will be the first to be questioned, and to receive judgment? And I heard a voice saying to me, The unclean spirits, along with the adversary. I bid them go into outer darkness, where the depths are. And I said: Lord, and in what place does it lie? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. As big a stone as a man of thirty years old can roll, and let go down into the depth, even falling down for twenty years will not arrive at the bottom of Hades; as the prophet David said before, And He made darkness His secret place.

And I said: Lord, and after them what nation will be questioned? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. There will be questioned of Adam's race those nations, both the Greek and those who have believed in idols, and in the sun, and in the stars, and those who have defiled the faith by heresy, and who have not believed the holy resurrection, and who have not confessed the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Ghost: then will I send them away into Hades, as the prophet David foretold, Let the sinners be turned into Hades, and all the nations that forget God. And again he said: They were put in Hades like sheep; death shall be their shepherd.

And again I said: Lord, and after them whom will You judge? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. Then the race of the Hebrews shall be examined, who nailed me to the tree like a malefactor. And I said: And what punishment will these get, and in what place, seeing that they did such things to You? And I heard a voice saying to me: They shall go away into Tartarus, as the prophet David foretold, They cried out, and there was none to save; to the Lord, and He did not hearken to them. And again the Apostle Paul said: As many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law, and as many as have sinned in law shall be judged by means of law. {{BIBLE:rom 2:12}}

And again I said: Lord, and what of those who have received baptism? And I heard a voice saying to me: Then the race of the Christians shall be examined, who have received baptism; and then the righteous shall come at my command, and the angels shall go and collect them from among the sinners, as the prophet David foretold: The Lord will not suffer the rod of the sinners in the lot of the righteous; and all the righteous shall be placed on my right hand, {{BIBLE:mat 25:33}} and shall shine like the sun. {{BIBLE:mat 13:43}} As you see, John, the stars of heaven, that they were all made together, but differ in light, {{BIBLE:1co 15:41}} so shall it be with the righteous and the sinners; for the righteous shall shine as lights and as the sun, but the sinners shall stand in darkness.

And again I said: Lord, and do all the Christians go into one punishment?— kings, high priests, priests, patriarchs, rich and poor, bond and free? And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. As the prophet David foretold, The expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever. Now about kings: they shall be driven like slaves, and shall weep like infants; and about patriarchs, and priests, and Levites, of those that have sinned, they shall be separated in their punishments, according to the nature of the peculiar transgression of each—some in the river of fire, and some to the worm that dies not, and others in the seven-mouthed pit of punishment. To these punishments the sinners will be apportioned.

And again I said: Lord, and where will the righteous dwell? And I heard a voice saying to me: Then shall paradise be revealed; and the whole world and paradise shall be made one, and the righteous shall be on the face of all the earth with my angels, as the Holy Spirit foretold through the prophet David: The righteous shall inherit the earth, and dwell therein for ever and ever.

And again I said: Lord, how great is the multitude of the angels? And which is the greater, that of angels or of men? And I heard a voice saying to me: As great as is the multitude of the angels, so great is the race of men, as the prophet has said, He set bounds to the nations according to the number of the angels of God.

And again I said: Lord, and after that what will You do? And what is to become of the world? Reveal to me all. And I heard a voice saying to me: Hear, righteous John. After that there is no pain, there is no grief, there is no groaning; there is no recollection of evils, there are no tears, there is no envy, there is no hatred of brethren, there is no unrighteousness, there is no arrogance, there is no slander, there is no bitterness, there are none of the cares of life, there is no pain from parents or children, there is no pain from gold, there are no wicked thoughts, there is no devil, there is no death, there is no night, but all is day. As I said before, And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold, that is, men who have been made like the angels through their excellent course of life; them also must I bring, and they will hear my voice, and there shall be one fold, one shepherd.

And again I heard a voice saying to me: Behold, you have heard all these things, righteous John; deliver them to faithful men, that they also may teach others, and not think lightly of them, nor cast our pearls before swine, lest perchance they should trample them with their feet. {{BIBLE:mat 7:6}}

And while I was still hearing this voice, the cloud brought me down, and put me on Mount Thabor. And there came a voice to me, saying: Blessed are those who keep judgment and do righteousness in all time. And blessed is the house where this description lies, as the Lord said, He that loves me keeps my sayings {{BIBLE:joh 14:23}} in Christ Jesus our Lord; to Him be glory for ever. Amen.

latex.p0002: 我们主耶稣基督被接升天以后，我若望独自在大博尔山上，祂也曾在那里向我们显示祂那无玷的天主性。我站立不住，就仆倒在地，向主祈祷说：主、我的天主，祢以我为配作祢的仆人，求祢垂听我的声音，并教导我关于祢来临的事。当祢来到大地时，将发生什么事？上天、大地、太阳、月亮，在那些时日中将发生什么事？求祢向我启示一切，因为我胆敢如此，是因祢垂听祢的仆人。
latex.p0003: 我祈祷了七天；此后，有一朵光云从山上将我提起，将我安置在天庭之前。我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{向上看，天主的仆人若望，你便知道。}我抬头一看，见天开了，从天上发出一股极其芬芳的香气；我又看见一道极其浩大的光，比太阳更灿烂。我又听见有声音对我说：\Quote{看，义人若望。}我定睛观看，见有一卷书卷，其厚度在我看来如同七座大山；其长度人无法测度，上面有七道封印。我说：\Quote{主、我的天主，求祢向我启示这书卷所写的是什么。}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{请听，义人若望。你所看见的这书卷中，记录了天上、地上、深渊中的事，以及全人类的审判与正义。}我说：\Quote{主，这些事何时发生？那些时日带来什么？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{请听，义人若望。在那时日，谷物和酒要丰盛，是地上从未有过、直至那些时日来到也未曾有的。那时，麦穗要产出一半\OriginalTerm{刻尼克斯}{chœnix}，枝条的弯曲处要结出一千串葡萄，每串葡萄要产出半缸酒；但到了第二年，在整个地面上将找不到半刻尼克斯的谷物或半缸酒。}
latex.p0004: 我又说：\Quote{主，此后祢要做什么？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{请听，义人若望。那时那\OriginalTerm{否认者}{denier}要出现，他就是那被安置在黑暗中的，称为\OriginalTerm{假基督}{Antichrist}的。}我又说：\Quote{主，求祢启示我他是什么样子。}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{他脸面晦暗；头上的头发像标枪一样尖锐；眉毛像野兽；右眼像早晨升起的星，左眼像狮子；嘴约一\OriginalTerm{肘}{cubit}；牙齿长\OriginalTerm{掌}{span}；手指像镰刀；脚掌长两\OriginalTerm{掌}{span}；额上有\OriginalTerm{铭文}{inscription}\InnerQuote{假基督}；他要高升到天上，也要被扔到\OriginalTerm{阴府}{Hades}，行虚假的奇事。那时，我要使天变为铜，不降雨水在地上；我要把云藏在隐密处，使它们不降雨在地上；我要命令风角，使风不吹在地上。}
latex.p0005: 我又说：\Quote{主，他在地上行这事多少年？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{请听，义人若望。那些时日将是三年；我要使三年像三个月，三个月像三周，三周像三天，三天像三小时，三小时像三秒钟，正如先知达味所说：\InnerQuote{祢将他的宝座推倒在地；祢缩短了他时日中的日子；祢使他蒙受羞辱。}那时，我要派遣哈诺客和厄里亚去揭露他；他们要指明他是说谎者和欺骗者；他要在祭台前杀死他们，正如先知所说：\InnerQuote{那时，他们要在祢的祭台上献上牛犊。}}
latex.p0006: 我又说：\Quote{主，此后将发生什么事？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{请听，义人若望。那时全人类都要死亡，整个地面上没有一个活人。}我又说：\Quote{主，此后祢要做什么？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{请听，义人若望。那时我要派遣我的天使，他们要取来那藏在云中的公羊角；米迦勒和加俾额尔要从天上出来，用那些角吹号，正如先知达味所预言的：\InnerQuote{用角声的响声。}那号角的声音要从世界的一端传到另一端；因那号角的声音，全地都要震动，正如先知所预言的：\InnerQuote{鸟声一响，一切植物都要兴起。}这就是说，在总领天使的声音中，全人类都要复活。}
latex.p0007: 我又说：\Quote{主，从亚当直到今日已死的人，以及从元始以来住在阴府的人，并在末期中死去的人，他们复活时要像什么样子？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{请听，义人若望。全人类都要以三十岁的年纪复活。}
latex.p0008: 我又说：\Quote{主，他们死时有男有女，有老者、少者，还有婴儿。在复活中，他们要像什么样子？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{请听，义人若望。正如蜜蜂，它们彼此没有区别，全是同一形状、同一大小，同样，每个人在复活中也是如此。没有美貌、红润、黝黑，没有埃塞俄比亚人，也没有不同的面貌；他们都以同一面貌、同一身材复活。全人类都要以无身体的状态复活，正如我告诉你的：在复活中，他们也不娶也不嫁，而是如同天主的天使一样（\BibleRef{玛 22:30}）。}
latex.p0009: \Quote{我又说：}\Quote{主，在那个世界里，人能否彼此认识？兄弟认识兄弟，朋友认识朋友，父亲认识自己的儿女，儿女认识自己的父母？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{听，若望。义人有认识，罪人却毫无认识；他们在复活中不能彼此认识。}我又说：\Quote{主，在那里是否有对世上事物的回忆，无论是田地、葡萄园，或别的东西？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{听，正义的若望。先知达味曾说：\BibleQuote{我记起我们原是尘埃：至于人，他的岁月如草；他必如田野的花一样茂盛：因为风吹过它，它就不复存在，它的地方也不再认识它。}他又说：\BibleQuote{他的灵魂要离去，他回归他的尘土；那一天，他的一切思想都要消灭。}}
latex.p0010: \Quote{我又说：}\Quote{主，之后祢要做什么？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{听，正义的若望。那时，我要派遣我的天使遍行全地，他们将把地上一切可敬的、一切珍贵的、可敬而神圣的圣像、光荣而珍贵的十字架、教会的圣器、神圣的经书都提起来；一切珍贵而神圣之物都将被云彩提到空中。然后，我命令将那伟大可敬的权杖提起来，就是那上面我伸展了我双手的，我所有的天使都要朝拜它。然后，所有人类都要被云彩提起来，正如宗徒保禄所预言的：见：\BibleRef{得前 4:17}。我们将和他们一同被提到云彩中，到空中与主相遇。那时，所有恶灵，无论是地上还是深渊中的，凡在普天之下的，从日出到日落，都要出来，与那被魔鬼所服事的，即假基督，联合，他们也要被提到云彩上。}
latex.p0011: \Quote{我又说：}\Quote{主，之后祢要做什么？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{听，正义的若望。那时，我要派遣我的天使遍行全地，他们要焚烧地，深八千五百肘，大山要被焚毁，所有岩石要熔化，成为灰尘，每棵树要被烧尽，每只走兽，每条爬行在地面上的爬虫，每样在地面上行动的东西，每只飞翔在空中的飞鸟；在地上将不再有任何移动之物，地也不再移动。}
latex.p0012: \Quote{我又说：}\Quote{主，之后祢要做什么？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{听，正义的若望。那时，我要揭开东方的四部分，就有四股大风吹来，他们要扫荡全地，从地的一端到另一端；主要从地上扫除罪恶，地要变得白如雪，又变成像纸一样，没有洞穴，没有山，没有丘，没有岩石；但从日出到日落，地面要像桌子一样平坦，白如雪；地的内部要被火吞噬，它向我呼喊说：\InnerQuote{主，我在你面前是个贞女，我里面没有罪。}正如先知达味从前所说：\BibleQuote{你用牛膝草洒我，我就洁净；你洗涤我，我就比雪更白。}他又说：\BibleQuote{一切深谷要填满，一切山岳丘陵要削平，弯曲的要修直，崎岖的要变成平坦；凡有血肉的，都要看见天主的救恩。}见：\BibleRef{依 40:4}}
latex.p0013: \Quote{我又说：}\Quote{主，之后祢要做什么？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{听，正义的若望。那时，地要从罪恶中被洁净，全地要充满馨香，因为我快要降在地上；然后那伟大可敬的权杖要出来，有成千上万的天使朝拜它，如我先前所说；然后，人子的记号要从天上出现，带着大能和大光荣。见：\BibleRef{玛 24:30}。那时，不义者和他的仆役要看见它，就极其切齿，所有不洁的灵都要逃跑。然后，他们被无形的力量抓住，无处可逃，就向他切齿，对他说：\InnerQuote{你的能力在哪里？你怎样领我们入了迷途？我们逃走了，失落了那在将要审判我们和全人类的祂身边所拥有的荣耀。我们有祸了！因为祂要把我们驱逐到外黑暗里。}}
latex.p0014: 我又说：\Quote{主，此后祢要做什么？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{那时我要从天上差遣一位天使，他要大声呼喊说：\InnerQuote{大地啊，请听，要刚强，主说：因为我正降临到你那里。}天使的声音要从世界的一端传到另一端，直到深渊的最远处。那时，众天使和那多目者的权能都要震动，天上要发出大声响，九重天都要震动，所有天使都要恐惧惊骇。那时，天要从日出之处裂开到日落之处，无数天使要降临到地上；那时，天库要敞开，他们要带来各样珍宝和乳香的芬芳，要把新耶路撒冷像新娘一样装饰的带到地上。}\BibleRef{默 21:2}那时，在我前面要有千万天使和总领天使，抬着我的宝座，呼喊说：\InnerQuote{圣、圣、圣，万军的上主；天地充满祢的光荣。}\BibleRef{依 6:3}那时，我要带着大能和大光荣出来，云中的众目都要看见我；那时，天上、地上和地下的众膝都要跪拜。\BibleRef{斐 2:10}那时，天要空无所有；我要降临到地上，空中所有的一切都要降到地上，全人类和一切恶神连同假基督，都要被带到我的面前，赤身露体，颈上锁着锁链。
latex.p0015: 我又说：\Quote{主，天、太阳、月亮和星辰将来会怎样？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{你看，义人若望。}我观看，就见一只羔羊有七只眼和七只角。\BibleRef{默 5:6}我又听见有声音对我说：\Quote{我要吩咐羔羊来到我面前，并对他说：\InnerQuote{谁要打开这书卷？}所有天使的群众都要回答：\InnerQuote{把这书卷交给羔羊来打开。}然后我要命令打开书卷。当他打开第一印时，天上的星辰要从一端坠落到另一端。当他打开第二印时，月亮要被隐藏，不再有光。当他打开第三印时，太阳的光要被收回，地上不再有光。当他打开第四印时，天要消散，空气要陷入极大的混乱，如先知所说：\InnerQuote{天是祢手所作的工程；它们要消灭，而祢却要存留；它们都要像衣服一样老旧。}当他打开第五印时，地要裂开，地上所有审判席都要显露。当他打开第六印时，海的一半要消失。当他打开第七印时，阴府要显露。}
latex.p0016: 我又说：\Quote{主，谁将是第一个受审问和接受审判的？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{不洁的邪灵，连同那敌对者。我命他们进入外面的黑暗，就是深渊所在。}我又说：\Quote{主，那深渊位于何处？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{你听，义人若望。一块大到三十岁男子才可滚动的石头，让它坠入深渊，即使坠落二十年也到不了阴府的底部；正如先知大卫从前所说：\InnerQuote{祂以黑暗为祂的藏身之处。}}
latex.p0017: 我又说：\Quote{主，在他们之后，哪一族要受审问？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{你听，义人若望。亚当的后裔中，那些民族要受审问，就是希腊人，以及那些信偶像、信太阳、信星辰的人，那些以异端玷污信德的人，那些不信神圣复活的人，那些不承认圣父、圣子和圣神的人；那时我要把他们投到阴府，正如先知大卫所预言：\InnerQuote{愿罪人都转归阴府，所有忘记天主的民族。}他又说：\InnerQuote{他们像羊一样被放在阴府里；死亡要作他们的牧人。}}
latex.p0018: 我又说：\Quote{主，在他们之后，祢要审判谁？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{你听，义人若望。那时，希伯来民族要受查问，他们曾把我像犯人一样钉在树上。}我说：\Quote{他们既对祢行了这样的事，要受什么刑罚？在什么地方？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{他们要进入塔尔塔罗斯，正如先知大卫所预言：\InnerQuote{他们呼求，却无人拯救；他们向主呼号，主也不俯听他们。}宗徒保禄又说：\InnerQuote{凡没有法律而犯罪的人，也要在没有法律中丧亡；凡在法律之内犯罪的人，要凭法律受审判。}\BibleRef{罗 2:12}}
latex.p0019: 我又说：\Quote{主，那些领受圣洗的人又怎么样？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{那时，领受圣洗的基督徒之民要受查问；然后义人要遵我的命令前来，天使要去从罪人中把他们收集出来，正如先知大卫所预言：\InnerQuote{主不许罪人的棍杖停留在义人的份上。}所有义人要安置在我的右边，\BibleRef{玛 25:33}并要像太阳一样发光。\BibleRef{玛 13:43}你看，若望，天上的星辰，它们都是同时受造，但光明却有差别，\BibleRef{格前 15:41}义人和罪人也是如此；因为义人要发出光明，像太阳，而罪人要站在黑暗里。}
latex.p0020: 我又说：\Quote{主，难道所有基督徒都进入同一种惩罚吗？——君王、大司祭、司祭、宗主教、富人和穷人、为奴的和自由的？}我听见有声音对我说：\Quote{你听，义人若望。正如先知大卫所预言：\InnerQuote{穷人的期望永不落空。}关于君王：他们要像奴仆一样被驱赶，像婴儿一样哭泣；关于宗主教、司祭和肋未人，那些犯罪的人，要按照每人特定的过犯性质，在刑罚中被分开——有些进入火河，有些进入不死的虫，有些进入七口刑罚坑。罪人将分配到这些刑罚。}
latex.p0021: 我又说：\Quote{主，义人将住在哪里？}我听见有声音向我说：\Quote{那时乐园将被启示；整个世界与乐园将合而为一，义人将与我众天使一同在全地面上，正如圣神借着先知达味所预言的：\BibleQuote{义人必承受大地，并永远居住在其中。}}
latex.p0022: 我又说：\Quote{主，天使的数目何其多？哪一个是更大的，是天使还是人？}我听见有声音向我说：\Quote{天使的数目有多大，人类的种族也那么大，正如先知所说：\BibleQuote{祂按天主天使的数目，为万民定了界限。}}
latex.p0023: 我又说：\Quote{主，此后祢要做什么？世界将变成什么？求祢向我启示一切。}我听见有声音向我说：\Quote{正义的\Person{若望}，请听。此后没有痛苦，没有忧伤，没有呻吟；没有对罪恶的记忆，没有眼泪，没有嫉妒，没有对弟兄的怨恨，没有不义，没有傲慢，没有诽谤，没有苦毒，没有生活的忧虑，没有父母或子女的痛苦，没有对黄金的痛苦，没有邪恶的念头，没有魔鬼，没有死亡，没有黑夜，却尽是白昼。正如我以前说过的：\BibleQuote{我还有别的羊，不属于这羊栈}，就是说，那些藉着卓越生活行为而变得像天使一样的人；我也必须领他们来，他们将听我的声音，将来只有一个羊群，一个牧人。}
latex.p0024: 我又听见有声音向我说：\Quote{看，你已听见这一切，正义的\Person{若望}；将这些事交付给忠信的人，使他们也能教导别人，且不可轻视它们，也不要将我们的珍珠丢在猪前，免得它们用脚践踏。}\BibleRef{玛 7:6}
latex.p0025: 当我还在听这声音时，云彩将我带下，放在\Place{大博尔}山上。有声音向我说：\Quote{凡时时刻刻遵守正义、实行公义的人是有福的。存放这记述的房屋也是有福的，正如主说：\BibleQuote{爱我的人必遵守我的话}\BibleRef{若 14:23}因我们的主\Person{耶稣基督}；愿光荣归于祂，直到永远。阿们。}
